text:
Emma (CS): quick heads up - a few EU onboarding flows are returning 401 at SSO handoff. blocked activations for some trials. need ETA before i send customers a note.
Dan (Platform): looking now. which region & count?
Emma (CS): eu-west-1, 6 tenants (ticket #4150). flagging renewal-risk accounts first.
Leo (AM): got it, i'll prep outreach if this goes >2h.
Ruth (SRE): initial traces point to identity-proxy v2.2.0. Authorization header dropped for certain proxied paths.
Dan (Platform): rollback path available. starting canary rollback to v2.1.3, ETA restore ~20-35m.
Emma (CS): drafting interim message for affected customers, posting below for quick sign-off.
Emma (CS): `Hi — were investigating an authentication issue affecting some EU onboarding activations. Engineers are working on a mitigation; we expect restoration within ~30 minutes. If youre blocked, reply to this thread or join troubleshooting office hours at 10:30 UTC (link). Apologies for the disruption.`
Mina (Legal): interim wording fine. keep credits conditional in follow-up. include support alias.
Ruth (SRE): ops can manual re-run activations as workaround; add that line.
InfraBot: rollback to v2.1.3 triggered by dan.platform at 1766012400. details: https://k8s.console/rollouts/identity-proxy
Ruth (SRE): canary healthy. rolling out fully, monitoring auth logs.
Emma (CS): sending interim now to affected list and scheduling 30-min office hours. offering conditional 2-week credit for trial churn risk.
Leo (AM): approve credit & 1:1 enablement session. prepping calendar link.
Ruth (SRE): full rollback complete; auth errors returned to baseline. root cause: header parsing change in identity-proxy v2.2.0 stripped Authorization for multi-part requests. next steps: revert change, add integration test, and a post-deploy header probe.
Dan (Platform): opening PR for revert & test.
Emma (CS): CS action items: 1) interim sent (done); 2) send RCA + remediation + credit instructions in 45m; 3) schedule enablement sessions and one-click calendar for affected trials; 4) collect feedback via short survey and flag renewal-risk to AMs.
Leo (AM): i'll start outreach to renewal-risk accounts after RCA goes out.
Ruth (SRE): postmortem owners: dan.platform (fix & tests), ruth.sre (deploy & verification), emma.cs (customer comms), leo.am (renewal outreach).
Emma (CS): thanks all - posting RCA draft shortly for sign-off.
